title: Amber American Drumsticks Bowl
description: A peppery, amber-glaze chicken drumstick bowl with a glassy-sugar jelly that showcases a bold American flavor, served in a Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, honey, mustard, garlic, paprika, pepper, and 2 tbsp water in a bowl to make glaze.
Pat drumsticks dry and season with salt.
Arrange drumsticks on a baking tray and brush with half of the glaze.
Roast for 25 minutes, then flip drumsticks and brush with remaining glaze.
Continue roasting for another 20 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
While drumsticks roast, reduce leftover glaze in a saucepan over medium heat until thick and glossy, about 5 minutes.
Serve drumsticks in a Korean brass bowl, drizzle with glossy glaze, sprinkle parsley, and enjoy.
